labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3), every frame stepped through around each transition
rule: event frame = first frame whose frame centre (960,540) shows the scene on the other side of the surface: for an exit the above-water scene (sky, horizon, the back in air, even through droplets); for an entry the water column (including underwater bubble froth). crossing_first..crossing_last = frames in between where the lens is in surface foam or covered by a water sheet and neither side is recognisable at the centre.

events.note: lens in air with splash f0-f20; f21-f23 opaque water sheet; f24 first frame whose centre shows the water column
f416 last frame with the underwater view at the centre (foam just under the surface); f417-f436 surface foam then a draining water sheet; f437 first frame with sky at the centre (through droplets)
f490 last air frame; f491 waterline/sheet across the lens; f492 first frame with underwater froth at the centre
f2795 last frame of foam just under the surface; f2796-f2805 draining water sheet, sun visible through it; f2806 first frame with sky at the centre
